timeline.text: Transcribing someone in a video call meant one odd trick: let their voice play through your speakers, then catch it again with the mic.
That round trip added echo and noise, and failed outright on laptops with no mic path from the call.
Now the Web Speech API listens straight to the shared tab — like headphones beating a re-recorded speaker.
A fresh listener needs a moment to wake up, so the restart timer stretched from 6 to 12 seconds.
